source: pret/pokeemerald, branch multi-language (8baea5602), which builds the French, Italian and Spanish carts byte for byte; the European code paths are its `#if EUROPE` blocks.

class_name_swap.provenance: BufferStringBattle (src/battle_message.c:3937), on the French and Spanish carts only, swaps a TEAM AQUA or TEAM MAGMA trainer's class and name placeholders in every battle string that names both ("Sbire Team Aqua", "Soldado Equipo Aqua"); no battle string names such a trainer without the class.
